text.description: Welcome to this three bedroom semi-detached house with a conservatory and a detached garden studio - perfect for a home business. Offering excellent commuter links into Barnsley and Wakefield, this property will appeal to a wide variety of purchasers including first time buyers. The accommodation briefly comprises: entrance lobby, downstairs wc, lounge, dining room, kitchen, conservatory, three bedrooms (master en-suite) and family bathroom. Externally the property has a driveway, gardens and the detached garden studio.

rooms.name: Entrance Lobby
rooms.description: Having a main entrance door and internal doors into a downstairs wc and the lounge.

rooms.name: Downstairs WC
rooms.description: 1.80m x 1.03m (5' 11" x 3' 5") Comprising of a low flush WC and a vanity unit with a wash hand basin. Having an obscured double glazed window, a gas central heating radiator and an extractor fan.

rooms.name: Lounge
rooms.description: 3.97m (maximum) x 3.92m (13' 0" x 12' 10") Situated to the front aspect, having a double glazed window to the front aspect and one to the side aspect, a gas central heating radiator, an electric fire as a focal point, open plan stairs leading up to the first floor landing and twin doors providing access into the dining room.

rooms.name: Dining Room
rooms.description: 3.08m x 2.15m (10' 1" x 7' 1") Having adequate space for a dining table and chairs, a gas central heating radiator, a double glazed sliding door into the conservatory and an internal door into the kitchen.

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.description: 3.06m x 2.58m (10' 0" x 8' 6") The kitchen has a range of fitted wall and base units with complimentary work surfaces. Appliances comprise of an electric cooker and a 1.5 sink and drainer unit with a mixer tap. Having space and plumbing for a washing machine, a gas central heating radiator, a tiled floor and a pair of double glazed French doors leading into the conservatory.

rooms.name: Conservatory
rooms.description: 4.39m x 2.60m (14' 5" x 8' 6") Having a pair of double glazed French doors leading into the garden, a range of double glazed windows and a gas central heating radiator.

rooms.name: Master Bedroom
rooms.description: 3.06m x 2.68m (plus recess) (10' 0" x 8' 10") A double bedroom situated to the front aspect, having two double glazed windows, a gas central heating radiator, built-in wardrobes and access to an en-suite shower room.

rooms.name: En-suite Shower Room
rooms.description: 1.80m x 1.71m (5' 11" x 5' 7") A modern suite comprising of a shower enclosure with rainfall style shower and additional hand shower, plus a vanity unit with a wash hand basin and a low flush WC. Having an obscured double glazed window, a gas central heating radiator, ceiling spotlighting and an extractor fan.

rooms.name: Bedroom 2
rooms.description: 2.74m x 2.46m (maximum) (9' 0" x 8' 1") A double bedroom situated to the rear aspect, having a double glazed window and a gas central heating radiator.

rooms.name: Bedroom 3
rooms.description: 2.16m x 2.03m (7' 1" x 6' 8") A single bedroom situated to the rear aspect, having a double glazed window and a gas central heating radiator.

rooms.name: Bathroom
rooms.description: 1.84m x 1.80m (6' 0" x 5' 11") A recently installed modern suite comprising of a panelled bath, a vanity unit with a wash hand basin, plus a low flush WC. Having an obscured double glazed window, a gas central heating radiator, decorative wall tiling and an extractor fan.

rooms.name: OUTSIDE
rooms.description: The property has a twin gated driveway to the front aspect and a front garden. The rear garden is of a generous size and has had a detached garden studio erected. The studio total measurements are 6.22m x 5.19m. Having double glazed bi-folding doors to the front aspect, the studio also has a side facing double glazed uPVC access door, a range of double glazed windows, plus kitchenette and separate wc areas.

text.description:
GUIDE PRICE - £330,000 - £340,000

Step inside and be welcomed by a spacious hallway that flows effortlessly into a warm and inviting lounge, perfect for cozy evenings or entertaining guests. The formal dining room sets the stage for memorable family dinners, while the kitchen/diner offers a bright, modern space where cooking and gathering become the heart of the home. Imagine sunny mornings in the conservatory, with panoramic views of the beautifully maintained gardens — your personal oasis for relaxation or play. A convenient cloakroom adds to the practicality of this superb layout.

Upstairs, five generously sized bedrooms await, including a luxurious master suite complete with an en-suite bathroom for your ultimate privacy and comfort. The family bathroom is stylishly appointed to serve everyone’s needs, making busy mornings a breeze. Outside, a driveway leads to a garage, providing ample parking and storage options. The lovely, well-tended gardens offer a safe and serene outdoor space for children to play or for you to unwind after a long day.


This is more than just a house — it’s the perfect home for a modern family looking to enjoy spacious living, beautiful surroundings, and a fantastic location. Ready to move in and start making memories, this property offers a lifestyle filled with comfort and convenience. Imagine barbecues in the garden, homework sessions in the sunny conservatory, and plenty of space for everyone to grow and thrive.


Don’t miss the chance to make this exceptional family home yours! Book your viewing today and see first-hand the wonderful space and charm waiting for you in Royston. Your perfect family life starts here!

customerDescription.descriptionHTML:
Haybrook Barnsley

Barnsley is popular with everyone from first time buyers to families and those looking to downsize. There's everything you could need in terms of shops, restaurants and entertainment, and lots on the way as the centre of town is regenerated. Barnsley has a train station, and the M1, M62 and A1 road links are close by. Leeds is only 25 miles away, and Sheffield 17 miles.

The area is well served for schools, particularly primaries, with a wide range of 'good' and 'outstanding' schools. There's everything from large period homes to new build houses at Blenheim View (off Longcarr Lane) and by Harron Homes in Lundwood.

The Haybrook Barnsley team covers Barnsley and the wider area, including Dodworth, Gawber, Pogmoor, Darton and Mapplewell. Come and see us at 1 Market Hill in Barnsley, from Monday to Saturday, or give us a call.

Haybrook
